sources.description: According to ESPN’s lead league insider Adam Schefter and NFL Network’s lead league insider Ian Rapoport, the Denver Broncos are among the teams that have “pondered, or are expected to consider the possibility” of trading for Indianapolis Colts star running back Jonathan Taylor.
